resolved_samples.reasoning: Multiple candidates explicitly name various assessment instruments and specify their rater type. The Beck Depression Inventory (BDI), Children's Depression Inventory (CDI), Subjective Probability Questionnaire (SPQ), Center for Epidemiological Studies - Depression Scale (CES-D), Personal Beliefs Inventory (PBI), Issues Checklist (IC), State Anxiety Questionnaire (SAQ), Dysfunctional Attitude Scale (DAS), and Pleasant Events Schedule (PES) were identified as youth self-report (code 1). The Child Behavior Checklist (CBCL) and Issues Checklist were identified as parent-report (code 2). The Schedule for Affective Disorders and Schizophrenia for School-Aged Children, Epidemiological Version (K-SADS-E) was identified as clinician/researcher-rated (code 7).
